about_the_game:
Pungo is a fun PvP (player versus player) game, perfect for sharing and challenging friends. Inspired by the classic Pong, it adds a twist with adorable playable cats, original power-ups, and innovative levels full of challenges.

Each kitten has its own mix of abilities, unique stats, and distinct playstyles — try different combinations and find your best strategy to win!

Headbutt, belly-flop, or kick to charge energy and unleash super moves to dominate the field! Be the fastest kitten!

Challenge your friends, organize tournaments, and become the most victorious cat. Scratch mystery boxes, unlock new characters, discover their stories, and complete your collection in the adorable world of Pungo.

Now with Remote Play Together!

The feline fun goes farther than ever!
Thanks to Steam’s Remote Play Together feature, you can now challenge your friends (or enemies!) even if they’re miles away. Only one player needs to own the game — just invite your buddies directly through Steam and play as if you were on the same couch.

Pungo is all about sharing laughs, quick reflexes, and chaotic cat belly smashes — no matter where your rivals are!
Grab your controllers, connect those paws, and... let the ultimate cat duel begin!

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS or SteamOS 3.0
  • Processor: Intel Core i3
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.3 / Vulkan capable GPU
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS or SteamOS 3.0
  • Processor: Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU with Vulkan support and 2GB VRAM
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.13 High Sierra or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i3
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal capable GPU
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:

short_description: Two cats, a ball of yarn, and a duel full of reflexes and fun! Play solo or against a friend, use surprising power-ups, and unlock adorable kittens. With headbutts, belly bumps, and kicks on the court. Will you be the fastest cat? Show your skills in Pungo!
